market_summary: All four assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, BTCUSD) are in strong session downtrends below their respective VWAPs, EMA50 baselines, and Value Area Lows. However, each asset is currently consolidating near or bouncing from Session Lows with expanding ATR channels, without fresh RVOL > 2.0 spikes to support extended breakdown scalps. Patience is warranted across the board.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3911.54) and below POC (3978.13), demonstrating severe value area breakdown. CVD is BEARISH at -8.24, confirming structural seller control. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below VWAP (3939.27) and EMA50 (3924.90). Candles are hovering near the lower ATR band (3869.69). Recent volume spike 11 bars ago triggered the flush, though current RVOL is 0.921. S/R context shows a hold above Session Low (3852.35). GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING with price below Gamma Flip (3878.34), accelerating downside continuation toward Put Wall #1 (3824.04). However, current candle is hovering mid-consolidation off Session Lows without immediate breakout volume, favoring HOLD for better entry.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (1.10750) and below POC (1.10943). CVD is NEUTRAL (+1157.19) showing diverging order flow against the downward trend. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (1.10815) and EMA50 (1.10817). ATR channel is expanding with price riding the lower band (1.10566). RVOL is 1.152 without high-volume yellow spikes currently. Support at Session Low (1.10533) is holding with repeated wicks, creating a chop zone rather than clean continuation. CVD divergence and support consolidation warrant a HOLD.

Price is below VAL (1.32533) and below POC (1.32731). CVD is BEARISH (-7624.32), though cvd_slope (+6711.99) shows short-term buying absorption. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is below both VWAP (1.32585) and EMA50 (1.32591). Price recently bounced from the lower ATR band (1.32290) and is consolidating mid-range below S/R 1.32500. RVOL is 1.264 without an active breakout yellow spike. Session Low at 1.32210 rejected strongly with long lower wicks, creating poor risk-reward for short continuation and insufficient catalyst for a reversal. HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (72396.0) and below POC (73501.6). CVD is BEARISH (-0.08) reflecting persistent selling pressure over the session. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades deeply below declining VWAP (72899.82) and EMA50 (72682.40). Price breached the lower ATR band (71304.43) and is currently in a minor mean-reversion pause. Last RVOL is 1.096 with no fresh breakout yellow spike. A liquidity sweep occurred at Session Low (71141.0), followed by an inside bar pause. Mid-channel consolidation after an extended move warrants a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish heavy trend below VWAP and EMA50
